title: Iterative Algorithms and Convergence Analysis for Constrained Nonlinear Multi-Parameter Eigenvalue Problems in the Complex Domain

contributions.purpose: 求解复域约束非线性多参数特征值问题(NMEP)
contributions.mechanism: 混合迭代算法:变分法+修正幂迭代,拉格朗日乘子强约束+改进Gram-Schmidt正交化,含Newton式参数更新
contributions.evaluation: 三算例收敛:实例1(20迭代,误差1e-6),实例2(40,5e-6),实例3(60,1e-5)——但数据由脚本模拟生成,非真实运行
contributions.domain: 数值线性代数/非线性特征值问题
contributions.source_quote: This paper introduces a novel hybrid iterative algorithm designed to solve nonlinear multi-parameter eigenvalue problems, specifically those characterized by complex domain constraints.

contributions.purpose: 刻画算法在困难情形下的收敛行为
contributions.mechanism: 对良态/病态、孤立/非孤立、非全纯解集分别做收敛性分析
contributions.evaluation: 良态且孤立解处二次收敛;非孤立/非全纯解处收敛变慢或依初值收敛到不同解(trade-off,负面情形)
contributions.source_quote: Conversely, non-isolated and non-holomorphic solutions lead to slower convergence or the possibility of reaching different solutions based on initial guess selection.

contributions.purpose: 论证相对传统方法的优越性
contributions.mechanism: 与幂法、Newton法在三算例上对比迭代数
contributions.evaluation: 实例A:混合15迭代 vs 幂法100+ vs Newton>50(不收敛);实例C:25 vs 200+ vs 不收敛——但Table2的A/B/C迭代数(15/20/25)与Table1的1/2/3(20/40/60)对不上
contributions.source_quote: the hybrid algorithm converged in approximately 15 iterations. In contrast, the power method required over 100 iterations, while Newton's method failed to converge within 50 iterations.

self_declared_provenance.quote: The algorithm cleverly combines the strengths of variational and modified power methods, directly addressing challenges arising from non-isolated and potentially non-holomorphic solution sets.

notes: 数据可信度重大红旗:附录A.2明确用Python脚本(simulate_NMEP/simulate_solver_step返回np.random.rand()占位)按指数衰减模型缩放生成Table1和Figure1的收敛曲线,却在正文声称'The results presented in the main text were generated from these actual computational runs'——实验数据实为编造/仿真而非真实求解。数字不一致:Table1(实例1/2/3=20/40/60迭代)与Table2(实例A/B/C=15/20/25迭代)矛盾;Figure1被反复复用于收敛曲线/µ关系图等多处。checklist问7自认实验为simulation却答NA。AI披露:实验设计/数据分析/写作均自评[D](AI主导>95%)。负结果见C2(非孤立/非全纯情形收敛退化)。非全纯情形无收敛定理,作者用仿真'替代证明'但checklist问3仍答[Yes]声称有完整证明。
